input.content:
# ice40_hdmi_node: report

## Result

**No release export was produced.** Six exports were allowed and five were run (export_1, 2, 3, 4, 5). None is routed and fabrication-ready, so there is no `export/` folder. A draft was never exported (`allow_incomplete` was never set). The best export is `export_2/`. `ice40_hdmi_node.synth` is restored to the source that produced `export_2`, and the placement sidecar is empty on purpose. A re-export of this source should reproduce export_2; I did not re-run it.

| Export | Change from the previous one | Nets connected | kicad-cli DRC errors | Unconnected | Return-via blockers | State |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| export_1 | first source; TMDS balls on the left column; pair class pinned to F.Cu and B.Cu, clearance 0.15 mm | 46 of 46 | 9 | 0 | 10 | validation_failed |
| **export_2** | TMDS balls moved beside GND balls; TMDS clearance 0.127 mm; pair class pinned to F.Cu | 46 of 46 | **0** | 1 | 11 | validation_failed |
| export_3 | `escape { method channel }` on the FPGA, TMDS balls on the left column | not routed | not run | not run | not run | rejected: escape left 7 of 23 balls unescaped (CK_P_SRC, CRESET_B, D0_N_SRC, D0_P_SRC, D1_P_SRC, D2_N_SRC, SDA_FPGA) |
| export_4 | back to `underpad`, TMDS balls on the left column | 46 of 46 | 9 | 0 | 16 | validation_failed |
| export_5 | TMDS balls on the bottom row and left corner; source resistors pinned in the sidecar | 42 of 46 (HDMI_CK_P, HDMI_D1_N, HDMI_D1_P, HDMI_D2_N open) | 9 | 4 | 16 | validation_failed |

The blocking reasons of `export_2`, copied from the router run record:
1. The kicad-cli DRC reports one item: `Missing connection between items (Track [+1V2] on F.Cu, length 1.4 mm / Track [+1V2] on In3.Cu, length 2.5456 mm)`.
2. Eleven signal vias fail the return-via rule ("no ground return via within 0.80 mm, and no spot in the GND pour holds one"), at (48.75, 34.35), (48.75, 37.55), (46.35, 33.55), (47.15, 38.35), (47.15, 32.75), (40.70, 33.60), (31.40, 39.70), (46.80, 40.80), (48.70, 41.30), (37.70, 40.20) mm and one more.
3. Five of these are escape vias of the TMDS source nets at balls D7, H7, J5, B5 and C4. I matched them to the TMDS source nets by position; I did not read the PCB. The balls D5, L5 and L7 (also TMDS) passed. The others are source-resistor pad vias, which I matched by coordinates.
4. The engine verdict is `rejected` in every export. It was not investigated.

## What the board is

An iCE40HX4K-BG121 (`ice40hx4k_bg121_nc`) drives an HDMI Type-A receptacle (`hdmi_a_receptacle`) with DVI-style single-link TMDS (three data pairs and the clock pair). It is a resistor-source output, **not** an HDMI-compliant transmitter, and no compliance is claimed.

- **Layers and fabrication:** 6 layers, `manufacturer "jlc-advanced"`, `requires via_in_pad`.
- **Input power:** a JST XH 2-pin terminal (J1), a 1.1 A hold polyfuse (F1, MF-MSMF110/16-2), a TVS (D1, PTVS6V0S1UR, 6.0 V standoff above a 5.5 V maximum input), then a Schottky reverse-polarity diode (D2, SS36), giving the +5V rail.
  - The clamp voltage of the PTVS6V0S1UR is **not recorded in the registry** and I did not look it up. The "clamp below what it protects" check is therefore **not done**.
  - The regulator and FPGA absolute maximums are also not checked here.
- **Rails:** AMS1117-3.3 (U1), then TLV70012DDCR (U2, 1.2 V core) from +3V3.
  - The PLL supplies VCCPLL0 and VCCPLL1 each go through a ferrite bead (L1, L2) and 100 nF.
  - Every FPGA supply ball has its own 100 nF 0402 (C10 to C22).
  - U1 has 2 x 10 uF on its input and on its output, as the registry requires.
  - U2 has 1 uF on its input and on its output.
- **Configuration:** U4 (`w25q128jvsiq_208mil`) is wired to the master SPI balls SDO, SDI, SCK and SS. /WP and /HOLD have 10 k pull-ups. CRESET_B has a 10 k pull-up and a test point. CDONE has a 10 k pull-up, a test point and a green LED. There is no MCU and no USB-UART bridge.
- **Clock:** a 25 MHz oscillator (X1) feeds the global-buffer ball B7 (`iot_197_gbin1`). B6, the ball typed as a clock output, is left unconnected (see defect 3).
- **HDMI side:**
  - +5V goes through a 0.5 A polyfuse (F2, MF-NSMF050-2, the nearest registry part to a 50 mA HDMI supply) to pin 18.
  - D3 (SRV05-4) protects SDA, SCL and HPD.
  - DDC is level-shifted by two IRLML6244 MOSFETs (gate on +3V3, 2 k pull-ups to +5V on the connector side, 10 k pull-ups to +3V3 on the FPGA side).
  - HPD goes through a 10 k / 20 k divider (5 V to about 3.3 V) to the FPGA.
  - There are no AC-coupling capacitors: DVI-style TMDS is DC-coupled to the sink's pull-ups to its own 3.3 V.
- **Indicators and mounting:** four status LEDs with 470 ohm resistors, two M2.5 mounting holes (top-left and bottom-right hints), and test points on +5V, +3V3, +1V2, GND, CDONE, CRESET_B and +5V_HDMI.

### TMDS drive arithmetic

The sink terminates each line with 50 ohm to 3.3 V. Each FPGA output drives its line through 270 ohm, so a "low" output pulls the line down against the 50 ohm termination.

- Assumed driver output resistance: 30 ohm. **This is my assumption**, not a datasheet value.
- Line low level: 3.3 V x (270 + 30) / (270 + 30 + 50) = 2.83 V.
- Single-ended swing: 3.3 - 2.83 = 0.47 V, inside the 0.4 to 0.6 V TMDS swing range.
- Low-state current per line: 3.3 V / 350 ohm = 9.4 mA.

I did not check the iCE40 output drive strength or its maximum toggle rate at 250 Mbit/s. The 25 MHz pixel clock implies a 250 Mbit/s bit rate; I make no claim that the iCE40 I/O reaches it.

### Declared stackup and impedance arithmetic

The stackup is declared in the source. It is this design's assumption, not a fabricator preset.

| Layer | Thickness | er |
|---|---|---|
| L1 copper | 0.035 mm | |
| prepreg | 0.11 mm | 4.2 |
| L2 copper (GND plane) | 0.0175 mm | |
| core | 0.36 mm | 4.6 |
| L3 copper | 0.0175 mm | |
| core | 0.52 mm | 4.6 |
| L4 copper | 0.0175 mm | |
| core | 0.36 mm | 4.6 |
| L5 copper | 0.0175 mm | |
| prepreg | 0.11 mm | 4.2 |
| L6 copper | 0.035 mm | |

The total is 1.6 mm.

- Single-ended microstrip, w = 0.13 mm, h = 0.11 mm, t = 0.035 mm, er = 4.2: `synth_evaluate_thermal_si` gives Z0 = 57.10 ohm. The IPC-2141 formula by hand gives 57.08 ohm.
- Edge-coupled differential estimate: Zdiff = 2 x Z0 x (1 - 0.48 x exp(-0.96 x s / h)) = 99.3 ohm for s = 0.15 mm.

  - +5V goes through a 0.5 A polyfuse (F2, MF-NSMF050-2, the nearest registry part to a 50 mA HDMI supply) to pin 18.
  - D3 (SRV05-4) protects SDA, SCL and HPD.
  - DDC is level-shifted by two IRLML6244 MOSFETs (gate on +3V3, 2 k pull-ups to +5V on the connector side, 10 k pull-ups to +3V3 on the FPGA side).
  - HPD goes through a 10 k / 20 k divider (5 V to about 3.3 V) to the FPGA.
  - There are no AC-coupling capacitors: DVI-style TMDS is DC-coupled to the sink's pull-ups to its own 3.3 V.
- **Indicators and mounting:** four status LEDs with 470 ohm resistors, two M2.5 mounting holes (top-left and bottom-right hints), and test points on +5V, +3V3, +1V2, GND, CDONE, CRESET_B and +5V_HDMI.

### TMDS drive arithmetic

The sink terminates each line with 50 ohm to 3.3 V. Each FPGA output drives its line through 270 ohm, so a "low" output pulls the line down against the 50 ohm termination.

- Assumed driver output resistance: 30 ohm. **This is my assumption**, not a datasheet value.
- Line low level: 3.3 V x (270 + 30) / (270 + 30 + 50) = 2.83 V.
- Single-ended swing: 3.3 - 2.83 = 0.47 V, inside the 0.4 to 0.6 V TMDS swing range.
- Low-state current per line: 3.3 V / 350 ohm = 9.4 mA.

I did not check the iCE40 output drive strength or its maximum toggle rate at 250 Mbit/s. The 25 MHz pixel clock implies a 250 Mbit/s bit rate; I make no claim that the iCE40 I/O reaches it.

### Declared stackup and impedance arithmetic

The stackup is declared in the source. It is this design's assumption, not a fabricator preset.

| Layer | Thickness | er |
|---|---|---|
| L1 copper | 0.035 mm | |
| prepreg | 0.11 mm | 4.2 |
| L2 copper (GND plane) | 0.0175 mm | |
| core | 0.36 mm | 4.6 |
| L3 copper | 0.0175 mm | |
| core | 0.52 mm | 4.6 |
| L4 copper | 0.0175 mm | |
| core | 0.36 mm | 4.6 |
| L5 copper | 0.0175 mm | |
| prepreg | 0.11 mm | 4.2 |
| L6 copper | 0.035 mm | |

The total is 1.6 mm.

- Single-ended microstrip, w = 0.13 mm, h = 0.11 mm, t = 0.035 mm, er = 4.2: `synth_evaluate_thermal_si` gives Z0 = 57.10 ohm. The IPC-2141 formula by hand gives 57.08 ohm.
- Edge-coupled differential estimate: Zdiff = 2 x Z0 x (1 - 0.48 x exp(-0.96 x s / h)) = 99.3 ohm for s = 0.15 mm.
- Declared target: 100 ohm differential.

**Caveat:** the pair spacing is **not declared** and was **not measured as routed**, so 99.3 ohm is the arithmetic for s = 0.15 mm only. I can only claim the width (netclass `trace_width 0.13 mm`) as declared.

### Net classes

| Class | Width | Clearance | Via (diameter / drill) | Pinned layers | Edge rate | Applied to |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| TMDS | 0.13 mm | 0.127 mm | 0.46 / 0.2 mm | F.Cu | fast | the 8 `HDMI_*_P/N` nets |
| TMDS_SRC | 0.13 mm | 0.127 mm | 0.46 / 0.2 mm | none | fast | the 8 `*_SRC` nets (ball to source resistor) |
| CLK | 0.127 mm | 0.15 mm | 0.46 / 0.2 mm | none | fast | the 25 MHz clock net |
| PWR | 0.4 mm | 0.127 mm | 0.46 / 0.2 mm | none | slow | all rails and ground |
| SIG | 0.127 mm | 0.127 mm | 0.46 / 0.2 mm | none | slow | SPI, DDC, HPD, CDONE, CRESET_B, flash straps, LEDs |

- The TMDS class was pinned to F.Cu to keep each pair on one layer. In `export_2` the pair nets showed no violation of Synth's own pin rules (`netclass TMDS stays off ...`, `netclass TMDS changes no layer`) in the kicad-cli DRC. I take that as: no HDMI pair net changed layers in export_2. I did not measure it from the copper.
- `diff_pair` declarations: four, with `impedance 100ohm` and `max_skew 0.15mm` per pair.
- No `plane` is declared on any class.
- TMDS_SRC, CLK and TMDS are the only classes without `edge_rate slow`. I did **not** declare the TMDS source nets slow, because they carry the unfiltered driver edge. That choice is what leaves the return-via blockers in the table above.

### Power budget

These are my estimates from the design, not measurements.

| Item | Estimate |
|---|---|
| TMDS drivers, up to 4 lines low at 9.4 mA | about 38 mA |
| iCE40 core and I/O | about 20 mA |
| Flash | about 25 mA |
| Oscillator | about 5 mA |
| LEDs, 4 x about 3 mA | about 12 mA |
| +3V3 total | about 0.1 to 0.3 A |
| U2 (1.2 V) load | below 0.1 A |
| HDMI +5V supply | up to 55 mA at the connector |
| +5V input total | well below the 1.1 A fuse hold |

U1 dissipates about 0.36 W at 0.2 A and 1.2 V drop. `synth_evaluate_thermal_si` gives 57.4 C at 90 C/W. `synth_validate` warns "about 133 C (1200 mW)": it assumes a full 1 A load, which this board does not draw.

## Section 4 evidence: what I could and could not measure

I have only Read, Write, Edit and the Synth MCP tools. There is no script or file-parsing tool and I did not read the multi-hundred-kilobyte PCB text. **The following were therefore NOT measured, and I report no numbers for them:**
- the length of each pair member on the routed copper,
- each intra-pair skew and the inter-pair mismatch,
- the pair spacing and width as routed,
- the list of layer changes with their return vias.

What the tool reports show:
- All 46 nets connected in export_2, with 0 kicad-cli DRC errors and 1 unconnected item (the +1V2 track in the table above).
- 164 vias and 515 segments in export_2.
- The return-via blockers are the eleven vias in the table above.
- The inter-pair length match across D0, D1, D2 and CK **cannot be declared** in this Synth version (see defect 2). It is therefore only a design intent here.

## Placement measurements

The only placement review I read in full is the second one, before I switched the support parts to pin-qualified `near:` hints and before any export. Its numbers are not for the final source, and I did not re-run it. They are therefore **not evidence for export_2**. In that review:
- decoupling and load capacitors C20, C21, C17, C19 and C24 were 15 to 29 mm from the pins they serve (C24 was 15 mm from U4.vcc, limit 4 mm);
- test points TP1, TP3, TP4, TP5, TP6 and TP7 were 14 to 43 mm from their parts, against limits of 5 to 9 mm;
- the LED pair D6/D7 was laid out differently, with D7 14.8 mm from where D6 puts it relative to its resistor.

No per-part distance, connector edge gap, test-point distance or identical-circuit match was measured for any export. ERC was not run separately beyond the checks inside `synth_validate`. No 2D or 3D review was done.

## Synth defects and limitations hit

1. **Language reference is incomplete.** It lists `diff_pair { impedance }` only. The parser also accepts `max_skew <len>` and `couple <identifier>`. I found `couple edge` is rejected (`E-SYNTH-PARSE-028 expected couple identifier`); I could not find the allowed values, so I did not use `couple`. `edge_rate slow` in a netclass is accepted but is also absent from the reference.
2. **No syntax for pair spacing or inter-pair length matching.** Spacing and width can only come from the netclass. The reference has no group or lane-match statement, so "inter-pair match across the three data lanes and the clock" cannot be declared in the source.
3. **`ice40hx4k_bg121_nc` clock pin:** the ball B6 is typed as a clock output. Putting the 25 MHz oscillator on it fails `E-SYNTH-CLOCK-001` (two clock outputs on one net). I moved the oscillator to the ordinary global-buffer ball B7.
4. **Hard `near: U3.pin` hints are not honoured.** In export_4 the source resistors landed 6 to 20 mm from their balls, and in export_2 two landed about 10 mm away. The review also misattributes capacitors to the wrong IC ("C10 ... serves X1 gnd", "C20 ... serves X1.oe"), apparently because rails and ground are shared nets.
5. **Pinned layers are not enforced by the router.** With `layers "F.Cu"` pinned, export_4 and export_5 still put HDMI pair tracks on In1.Cu, In2.Cu and B.Cu, and vias on pair nets. The DRC rule Synth writes catches it, but the router does not respect it.
6. **Return-via rule cannot be satisfied on BGA escape vias of fast nets.** `underpad` puts a via in each used ball. Inside the ball field there is no spot for a ground via within 0.8 mm. Whether it passes depends on free space near the ball: D5, L5 and L7 passed, while D7, H7, J5, B5 and C4 failed. `channel` escape rejects 7 of 23 balls (export_3).
7. **J2 escape advisory** is printed in every run although `escape { off }` is set (`pads 23, pitch 0.5 mm, gap 0.000 mm`).
8. **Validation output is very large** (about 40 warnings per call, mostly `W-SYNTH-SUPPLY-002`, `E-SYNTH-SCHEM-003`, `E-SYNTH-SCHEM-001`). Several are artefacts of the schematic auto-layout, for example "decoupling capacitor 362 mm from its IC".
9. **Part provenance warnings:** the user-registry parts (`tlv70012_ddc`, `ice40hx4k_bg121_nc`, `w25q128jvsiq_208mil`) have no reviewer. Test points, mounting holes, ferrite beads and the oscillator carry no MPN or LCSC number.
10. **No synth tool to read the routed copper** (net length, pair spacing, layer changes), so section 4 cannot be produced from within the MCP tool set.

## What I could not do

- Produce a routed, fabrication-ready export (the blockers are in the table at the top).
- Produce `export/`.
- Measure pair lengths, skew, spacing, width and layer changes on the copper.
- Check the TVS clamp voltage and absolute maximums of the protected parts.
- Check the iCE40 output drive and speed for the 270 ohm TMDS source.
- Complete the placement-rule measurements of section 7.
- Run ERC beyond `synth_validate`, 2D or 3D review, or a datasheet check of the AMS1117 output-capacitor stability with ceramic-only capacitors.

- **Eleven signal vias with no ground return via within 0.8 mm:** the vias on the TMDS source nets (iCE40 ball to source resistor) are the ones I identified, five at escape vias on balls D7, H7, J5, B5 and C4. I matched them by position, not from the PCB.

- **Balls on the left column or bottom row:** these did worse, with 9 DRC errors in export_4 and 4 open nets in export_5.
- **TMDS source nets declared `edge_rate slow`:** I did not do this, since they carry the unfiltered driver edge and that would hide the failing rule.

**Not measured:** pair lengths, skew, inter-pair mismatch, pair spacing and width as routed, and the layer-change list. I have no tool that reads routed copper. The only impedance figures are arithmetic, from the declared stackup: single-ended Z0 = 57.1 Ω for w = 0.13 mm, and about 99 Ω differential if the spacing were 0.15 mm, which was never declared or measured.

**Not checked:** the TVS clamp voltage, the iCE40 output drive for the 270 Ω source, and any per-part placement distances for the final source. Section 7 placement measurements and ERC beyond `synth_validate` are also missing.

- There is no syntax for pair spacing or for inter-pair length matching.
- Pin-qualified `near:` hints are not honoured.
- The router ignores layers pinned in the netclass.
- The return-via rule cannot be met on BGA escape vias of fast nets.

The `.synth` is restored to the `export_2` source and the placement sidecar is empty. I did not re-run `export_2` to confirm it reproduces.
